title: Turn Daily Events into Peak Load
description: An app records 10 million events per day. Use 100,000 seconds per day for rough planning and a peak factor of 4. What peak rate should you compare with per-node capacity?

options.explanation: That is the rounded average, before the stated peak factor.
Multiplying daily volume by the peak factor without converting days to seconds mixes units.
10,000,000 / 100,000 gives about 100/s average; multiplying by 4 gives about 400/s peak. Rounding is explicit.
That is two orders of magnitude below the result of the daily-to-second conversion.
